name: ARA4102
title: Missing glyphs
summary: Some characters have no glyph in the bundled fonts and render as boxes.
html:
Some characters have no glyph in the bundled fonts and render as boxes.

#Common causes

  • A locale whose script is not covered by the font pack.

#Fixes

  • Supply a licensed font pack covering the reported clusters.

  • Code: ARA4102

  • Constant: ui::MISSING_GLYPHS

  • Reported by: ara-ui-test
